description: Returns the probability a player goes over or under a stat line (passing, rushing or receiving yards, TDs, attempts, completions, interceptions, receptions), with fair no-vig American odds for each side, the projected mean and spread, the week's game and betting line, and the model's backtest. Use it to price a player prop or compare a sportsbook line with a fair price. Players on bye or OUT/IR get p_over 0. Model estimate, not betting advice. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

espn_id.description: ESPN athlete id, instead of player_id.
espn_id.title: Espn Id

line.description: The line to price, or up to 10 comma-separated lines.
line.title: Line

player_id.description: The player (give this or espn_id). GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

stat.description: The stat the line is on.
stat.title: Stat

week.description: NFL week, 1-18. Default: the current week, or the next one if the player's game this week is already final.
week.title: Week

name: get_prop_probability

available.description: false on a bye or when unavailable; every p_over is then 0.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

game.description: The week's game, with the betting line.

injury_status_raw.description: Status as the source spelled it.

lines.description: Per line: the over/under probabilities and fair no-vig American odds.

model.description: Method, fitted dispersion and the walk-forward backtest (Brier score, calibration).

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

projection.description: Projected mean and standard deviation for the stat.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the player is unavailable, when he is.

title: Player prop probability (over/under)
